saw_lines: Supplement buyers pick one product for one goal, reorder it monthly, and trust a person using it over the label.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this fits their goal or keeps scrolling.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust. Lead the next batch with one review count or orders shipped on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and print it on every new creative.

6 of your 22 copy ads are creator posts with codes and handles, run from the brand page. Whitelist them from the creator accounts, then cut three variations of the strongest one with a fresh opening line.
Your copy ads never open with an offer, and codes sit at the end of creator posts. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in the first line of three new ads.

Your 22 copy ads use 16 different openings, and the biggest, the “forget everything” collagen story, opens 5 of them. Keep the two strongest stories and build the next batch from them, testing a new opening for each variation.

ads_1: Collagen and fruit stories rebuilt with proof and a first order offer
